item.title: Chemie-Lernen.org: My VR Education Project
item.description: Educational Innovation Through Virtual Reality This project represents my personal commitment to transforming education through immersive technology. Chemie-Lernen.org combines my expertise in XR development with educational research to create meaningful learning experiences. My Role and Vision As the creator and lead developer of Chemie-Lernen.org, I envisioned a platform that would: Bridge the gap between abstract chemistry concepts and tangible understanding Democratize access to high-quality science education regardless of location Pioneer web-based VR as an accessible alternative to expensive hardware solutions Contribute to research on the effectiveness of VR in educational settings Technical Implementation Journey Architecture Decisions I chose a stack optimized for accessibility and sustainability:
